title: PathNet path plus Mirror module role
hypothesis: At matched physical module bytes, adding a small layer-specific Mirror role coordinate to a PathNet-selected shared module improves fresh held-out path-task quality by at least 1 percentage point over PathNet path selection alone, while using fewer bytes than independent per-task modules.
physical_object: shared 2-layer modular linear supernetwork with 4 physical modules per layer
mirror_coordinate: per-task Givens role coordinate applied to selected module output
logical_multiplicity: held-out task pathways with distinct functional module roles
controls: PathNet path plus Mirror module role
shared module without path or Mirror

task.type: synthetic 4D two-layer regression with modular target pathways

success_gate: Every fresh world: path+Mirror quality improves by >=1pp over path-only on held-out paths; N=20 actual bytes below independent per-task modules; must report physical module count and compute.
failure_gate: Quality margin missed, simple path selection matches Mirror at equal/fewer bytes, or role coordinates collapse across held-out paths.
boundaries: Synthetic modular regression mechanism test only.
No language model or generic routing claim.
Path count alone is not capacity evidence.
